items.information: Full information on the [US Nationals 2006 website](http://www.chrisandkori.us/fw/main/U_S_Nationals_2006-1504.html). For certain events preliminary rounds will take place only on Friday. You must be present on Friday in order to qualify for the finals, which will take place on Saturday and Sunday.
